The output cut out about 20,000 characters in the middle. It ran from partway through `tests/test_utils/` to the failure tracebacks, and it included the final summary section. Any other failing files after `tests/test_utils/test__expand_args.py` are therefore not confirmed.

You asked for one plain run with no piping, so I haven't re-run it. If you want a verified list, I can re-run with `-rf` or write the output to a file. Neither changes any repo files.

The first six files were already modified in the working tree before I ran anything. I made no edits.
